description: Brushed alloy panels, a soft interior glow that clicks on before the door's even open, and a shelving array that reconfigures itself around whatever you put in it. The brand plate reads MERIDIAN COLD SYSTEMS — CRYOVAULT SERIES, in lettering too tasteful to be cheap. It probably knows what you keep in it.
